location_bar.name: Deuhtsh's Bar
location_bar.description: An old, run-down bar and the only building still intact in midst of a village reduces to rubble.

talk_barkeep.name: Talk to Deuhtsh
talk_barkeep.description: Talk to Deuhtsh standing behind the counter.

village_exit.name: Front Door
village_exit.description: The front door of the bar. Peeking through the tiny peep hole, some devastated buildings can be seen.

cellar_exit.name: Dusty Hatch
cellar_exit.description: An old, dusty hatch. The padlock keeping it shut can be opened with Deuhtsh's key.

location_village.name: Village Ruins
location_village.description: This village has been destroyed by a gigantic beast, it's footprints carved deep into the soil. The beast itself, however, is nowhere to be seen.

bar_exit.name: Door to the Bar
bar_exit.description: The bar's front door is littered with claw marks and slashes, but held strong against the assaults of the blood-possessed masses.

grassland_exit.name: Path to the great grasslands
grassland_exit.description: A trampled path leads out of the village, and into the great grasslands.

location_cellar.name: Cellar
location_cellar.description: A dusty cellar Deuhtsh once used to store food and booze. He hasn't cleaned here in ages...

collapsed_exit.name: Collapsed Corridor
collapsed_exit.description: This Corridor leads to the Ladder leading into the bar. However, it collapsed, barring you passage

bar_exit.name: Ladder to the Bar
bar_exit.description: This Ladder leads to the hatch in the back of the bar.
